targets.endpoint: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) by blinded independent central review (BICR) in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker positive population
targets.population: Previously untreated advanced non-squamous NSCLC, TROP2 biomarker positive, without actionable genomic alterations.
targets.comparison: Dato-DXd 6 mg/kg + durvalumab + carboplatin versus pembrolizumab + histology-specific platinum chemotherapy.
targets.success_definition: First official decisive primary analysis reports a favorable statistically qualifying PFS result by BICR in the non-squamous TROP2 biomarker-positive population under the prespecified SAP. Other populations, OS, unadjusted nominal p-values, commercial decisions and delayed readouts do not resolve this target. If multiplicity-adjusted qualification is unclear, adjudication remains unresolved.
targets.analysis_timepoint: First officially reported decisive analysis of the specified primary PFS hypothesis; registry timeframe approximately 3 years.

readout.label: H2 2026 公司指引；待更新核查

targets.status_note: 2026-10-22限定官方中英文检索未发现本目标决定性结果；不能排除未索引公告。注册记录预计主要完成时间2027-11，不能用其替换公司读出窗口。

readout_screen.finding: Retrieved results concerned TROPION-Breast02, TROPION-Lung01 or other trials, not the AVANZAR target.

evidence.title: AVANZAR registered design
evidence.text: Randomized open-label phase III AVANZAR, total enrollment 1350. There are four primary hypotheses: PFS and OS in non-squamous TROP2-positive and overall non-squamous populations. This target is only the TROP2-positive non-squamous PFS hypothesis. Alpha allocation, event counts, biomarker prevalence and missing-data estimand are not supplied. Registry estimated primary completion 2027-11 does not establish readout timing.

evidence.title: TROPION-Lung01 indirect randomized evidence
evidence.text: In previously treated non-squamous NSCLC, Dato-DXd monotherapy versus docetaxel showed PFS HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.51–0.79), subgroup n=229 versus 232. This is indirect evidence: later-line versus first-line, monotherapy versus triple combination, different comparator, and no isolation of the target TROP2 biomarker-positive population. It is not an AVANZAR treatment effect. Source was previously archived as a primary-reader excerpt, not a full paper download; no independent human review.
